answer_1.quote: We evaluate 13 such algorithms on 13 NLG evaluation datasets spanning five tasks viz., machine translation, summarization, data-to-text generation, paraphrase generation, and grammatical error correction.
answer_1.outputs: Generated texts from each NLG system that are compared pairwise

answer_2.quote: We experiment with a total of 10 direct assessment metrics viz. chrF, BLEU-4, ROUGE-L, Embedding Average, Vector Extrema, Greedy Matching, Laser, BertScore, MoverScore and Bleurt.

answer_4.quote: Then, we ask human annotators to compare the outputs of the chosen systems on a randomly sampled input context and provide the comparison outcome as feedback to the learner.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators view two generated texts along with the input context and indicate whether the first is better, worse, or equal (tie) in quality.
